## You’ve got questions, and you deserve answers.
You. Everyday Oklahomans. Not lobbyists, not billionaires, not super PACs. And definitely not AIPAC; I’m not here to sell my voice to the highest bidder. I believe public service should be about serving people, not padding bank accounts.
Correct. None. Zero. Zilch. If it comes with strings attached, I don’t want it.
Let’s just say we’re not out here treating politics like a get-rich-quick scheme. Grassroots means lean budgets, creative problem-solving, and more time with the people instead of endless donor dinners.
Because if you have to buy your way into viability, then the system is broken. The loudest voice in the room shouldn’t belong to the person with the fattest wallet.
People over politics — every single time.
Education reform that’s honest and equitable.
Healthcare access for all, especially rural and underserved communities.
Support for military families (I’m a military spouse myself).
Protections for Native sovereignty (I’m Chickasaw and proud).
Equity in autism care (my son is autistic and thriving because of early intervention).
Transparency & accountability in government — no excuses.

pages.title: POLICIES AND ISSUES — Jasmine Thomas for Oklahoma
pages.text:
## This Is Why I’m Running
for the United States Senate for Oklahoma to build a country where survivors are protected, families are supported, healthcare is accessible, work is respected, and no one is left behind because of disability, income, gender, or zip code.
This campaign is about using every tool available to a U.S. Senator: legislation, funding, oversight, and coalition building, to deliver real, measurable change.
These priorities aren’t campaign promises.
They’re the standard I’ll be held accountable to.
## Education
Education: should prepare children for life, not politics.
I will fight to:
Reduce class sizes and expand early intervention
Reduce overreliance on standardized testing
Guarantee free breakfast and lunch for all students
Fully fund special education
Ensure competitive teacher pay and retention
Keep partisan politics out of classrooms
## economic
Economic Justice & Cost of Living : No one working full time should struggle to survive.
I will fight for:
A living wage minimum wage
Strong price gouging protections
Investment in affordable housing
Food access as a basic right
Emergency housing and utility relief
## healthcare
Healthcare & Public Health: Healthcare is a human right, not a privilege.
I will work to:
Establish Medicare for All to guarantee universal healthcare coverage for every American and ensure that no one is denied care because they cannot afford it.
Protect and expand access to healthcare services , including primary care, preventative care, mental healthcare, reproductive healthcare, and prescription medications.
Strengthen rural healthcare systems by protecting rural hospitals, expanding access to specialists, and investing in emergency and maternal healthcare services.
Support healthcare workers by addressing staffing shortages, workplace violence, burnout, and unsafe working conditions.
Create accountability within healthcare systems so patients receive timely, quality care without unnecessary barriers created by private insurers.
Treat environmental protection as public health policy by addressing pollution, unsafe water, and environmental factors that contribute to chronic illness.
Expand access to maternal healthcare, pediatric care, hospice, palliative care, and long-term care services.
Protect Medicaid and ensure healthcare programs serve patients first, not corporate interests.
## women
Reproductive Rights & Women’s Health: Decisions about pregnancy belong to patients, not politicians.
I will fight to:
Restore Roe v. Wade federally
Protect women from prosecution for miscarriage or pregnancy complications
Guarantee care for survivors of rape, incest, and trafficking
## childcare
Childcare & Family Support: Families cannot thrive without reliable childcare.
I will push for:
Universal, affordable childcare — including 24/7 options
Treating childcare as federal infrastructure
Paid family and medical leave
Step-down childcare assistance to eliminate income cliffs
Childcare access for students, military families, and shift workers
## welfare
Foster Care & Child Welfare: Children in care deserve stability, safety, and connection.
I will fight for:
Federal foster care oversight standards
## Environment
Environmental Protection: Clean water and clean air are non-negotiable.
I will fight to:
Strengthen the Clean Water Act
Protect tribal water sovereignty
Invest in rural water infrastructure
## civil rights
Civil Rights & LGBTQIA+ Protections : Civil rights must be protected, not debated.
Protect trans youth and their families
Safeguard voting access for disabled Americans
## consumer
Credit, Housing & Consumer Protection : The system should not trap people in permanent debt.
A Credit Renewal Act to reset credit every five years
Forgiveness of old debt after consistent payments
Hardship protections for medical crises or job loss
Accountability for predatory lenders
Strong protections against exploitative landlords
## Military
Military Veterans & Families: Service should never mean sacrifice without support.
I will work to:
Ensure fair military pay that reflects real family costs
Fix inaccurate BAH and BAS calculations
Protect military spouse employment
Expand childcare access during deployments
Improve staffing and access in veteran healthcare systems
## workers
Workers’ Rights & Labor : Work should provide stability. Not burnout.
32-hour, full-pay workweek pilot programs
A right to disconnect from work after hours
Safe staffing ratios for healthcare workers
Paid leave and caregiver protections
## Disability
Disability & Autism Advocacy : Disabled Americans deserve access, dignity, and support across their lifespan.
Expand autism and disability services nationwide
Reduce therapy waitlists and enforce insurance coverage
Strengthen IEP enforcement and accountability
Protect Social Security and disability benefits
End SSA clawbacks and modernize outdated disability standards
Expand respite care and family support services
## Safety
Survivor Safety & Violence Prevention : Survivors deserve protection, not punishment.
I will fight to:
Expand the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) to cover friendship-, family-, and roommate-based violence
Mandate trauma-informed training for law enforcement, EMS, and first responders
Protect survivors from criminalization for self-defense or survival
Strengthen protections for Missing & Murdered Indigenous Women (MMIW)
Establish rideshare violence reporting and accountability standards
Expand post-assault recovery services including therapy, housing, and legal aid
This platform reflects what I will fight for every day, in every committee, in every budget negotiation.
Progress does not happen all at once. It happens when leaders are honest, persistent, and unwilling to look away from hard problems.
That is the kind of senator I will be.
